_comment: Controlled tag vocabulary for chronicles and entities. Applied by `php artisan tags:sync`. Order within a facet is the display order. `parent` makes a tag imply its ancestors (tagging Mesopotamia also tags Middle East and Asia). Top-level era tags are derived from dates. Sub-eras (Neolithic, Bronze/Iron Age) differ by region, so they are curated on chronicles only; their start_year/end_year is just a plausibility window an entity's dates must fit to inherit them from its chronicles.

era.name: Prehistory
era.description: Before writing, to c. 3000 BCE: foragers, the first farmers and the first villages.

era.name: Neolithic
era.description: The first farmers, herders and villages, and the Copper Age that follows.

era.name: Ancient
era.description: c. 3000–500 BCE: the first cities, writing, kingdoms and empires.

era.name: Bronze Age
era.description: Bronze-working societies of Eurasia and Africa, c. 3300–1200 BCE.

era.name: Iron Age
era.description: Iron-working societies of Eurasia and Africa from c. 1200 BCE.

era.name: Classical Era
era.description: c. 500 BCE – 500 CE: Greece and Rome, Persia, the Maurya and Gupta, Qin and Han.

era.name: Early Modern
era.description: c. 1500–1800 CE: oceanic empires, gunpowder states, the Renaissance and the Enlightenment.

era.name: Modern
era.description: c. 1800–1945 CE: industrialisation, nationalism, imperialism and the world wars.

era.name: Contemporary
era.description: 1945 to the present: the Cold War, decolonisation and globalisation.

region.name: Middle East
region.description: The Near East: Mesopotamia, the Levant, Anatolia, Arabia and Iran.

region.name: Western Europe
region.description: France, the Low Countries and the Rhineland.

region.name: Central Europe
region.description: The German lands, Austria, Switzerland, Bohemia, Poland and Hungary.

region.name: The Mediterranean
region.description: The Mediterranean basin as a connected world.

region.name: Indian Ocean
region.description: Monsoon trade and the coasts of the Indian Ocean.

region.name: Atlantic World
region.description: Connections across the Atlantic between Europe, Africa and the Americas.

region.name: Silk Roads
region.description: The overland routes linking China, Central Asia, Iran and the Mediterranean.

theme.name: Empires & States
theme.description: State formation, dynasties, empires and their politics.

theme.name: Farming & First Cities
theme.description: The origins of agriculture, villages, cities and urban life.

type.name: Regional history
type.description: A region or civilisation through an era.

type.name: Empire or dynasty
type.description: Follows one state, empire or dynasty.

type.name: War or campaign
type.description: Follows a war, a series of wars or a military campaign.

type.name: Peoples & cultures
type.description: A people, culture or archaeological horizon.
